verdicts.reason: Quotes verify (22.04.01-audience-geography-map.md:98 D-04; analytics-market-intelligence-cx.md:131; 22.08-credit-linked-performance-cx.md:84 R-02; 22.08.01:126; 22.08.03:58). But R-02's phrase 'excluded once, at the source' explicitly cites 22.04.01 D-04 as its authority in the same sentence, and every other consumer citation (22.08.01:126 'excluded upstream (cx R-02)', 22.08.03:58 'Excluded upstream (22.04.01 D-04)') points back to the same single decision. No statement instructs a second filter anywhere; the normative product rule — one exclusion point upstream, every consumer inherits it, no consumer re-decides fraud — is identical in all five places. Where that single filter physically sits in the pipeline (ingestion stage vs. the geography-map component) is a data-flow/component-boundary call for /create-prd-architecture, not a divergence in product behaviour at the vision layer.

Both quotes verify verbatim. 22.01.01-dsp-account-connection-sync.md:49-51 emits 'healthy when last_successful_sync < 26h, stale at 26h-50h'; 22.01.03-ingestion-health-gaps-freshness.md:49 fixes cadence at 'DSP daily-batch ~24h' and :54-55 define 'fresh' at age <= 1x cadence and 'stale' at 1x < age <= 3x. The numbers genuinely conflict (26h vs 24h boundary; stale ending at 50h vs continuing past 72h) and the state name differs (healthy vs fresh), with no marker on either. Downgraded from blocking because the same sentence at 22.01.01:47-48 explicitly assigns ownership — 'the classification of that timestamp into healthy / stale / broken is 22.01.03's job' — giving an implementer a stated precedence rule (22.01.03 wins) rather than forcing invention of product behaviour. The residual defect is the un-marked stale threshold set left standing in 22.01.01.

Quotes verify (22.01.04-manual-file-based-metric-import.md:50 and :54; 22.01-source-connections-ingestion-cx.md:73), though the claimed bold on 'the precedence rule applied' is not in the file. The referenced target does not say the rule 'does not exist' — cx.md:73 carries an explicit deferral marker '[PENDING — /ideate-discover Step 5 deepening]' AND states the operative ordering in the same line: 'live DSP connection > distributor file > manual entry, with the superseded value retained and inspectable rather than overwritten'. The user-override question the finding calls undetermined is answered one line up at cx.md:68 ('picks a source of truth, or accepts the default precedence'). A marked deferral carrying a stated candidate default plus a stated override is the documented mechanism, not a silent gap.

Quotes verify (22.04-audience-geography-routing-insight-index.md:46-47; 22.07-ar-scouting-watchlists-index.md:61-63; 22.07.02-momentum-breakout-signals.md:21; 22.05-cross-source-dashboard-reporting-index.md:37-40; 22.01-source-connections-ingestion-index.md:43). No implementer building 22.07 or 22.05 would strip the Operator on the strength of a prose note inside a sibling sub-domain's index; every reasonable reading converges on the same build.

Quotes verify (22.04.03-show-impact-attribution.md:22 Role Lens; :94 D-01; 22.04.01:97 D-03). The Role Lens cell is illustrative value-proposition prose using an 'X%' placeholder to describe what the Operator gets ('a genuine and honest sales asset'), while D-01 in the same file's Decisions section is the normative render rule, stated absolutely and unscoped ('Results are ranges with confidence and named confounders, never a headline percentage'). Decisions are the locked layer in this tree and D-01 admits no persona carve-out, so an implementer renders the Operator's aggregate as a range with confounders exactly like every other result. 22.04.01:97 D-03 is about never averaging across sources for one city — a different operation from aggregating across artists — so it does not compound the claim.

Quotes verify (22.07.04-scouted-artist-visibility-consent.md:58-59; 22.07-ar-scouting-watchlists-index.md:76 D-03). Not a silent contradiction: the exact substance — whether a label A&R exists as a separate actor or is absorbed as a Producer in an org context — is a live tracked deferral with owner and target at 22.07 index:82 Q-01 ('[OWNER] ... | User | /create-prd'), canonicalised again at analytics-market-intelligence-index.md:137 Q-02. Under the index's own stated mapping (index:40, and 22.07.03:20 'Their org-context version is the A&R case the parent's persona mapping absorbs'), a label scout is a Producer in an org context, so the consent copy is not asserting an unmodelled exposure. The wording of a benefit statement is UX microcopy that follows whatever Q-01 settles.

The question is answered in full at 22.05.01-unified-performance-dashboard.md:125 ('RESOLVED — neither', citing ideation-index.md D-31, v1 = session spine, all of domain 22 phase-2+) and again at analytics-market-intelligence-index.md:141 Q-06, which additionally preserves the 'ship together' finding against moscow-ledger.md. The finding's own forcedInvention concedes 'Nothing new about the product'. A stale un-struck parent row whose answer is recorded twice downstream is a bookkeeping lag, not an ambiguity an implementer can act wrongly on.

Quotes verify (22.03.01-playlist-placement-tracking.md:106 Q-02 '| User | MoSCoW |'; :19 Role Lens; :63 edge case). Q-02 is a scope-reduction question carrying an explicit owner (User), and the feature's behaviour is fully and normatively specified regardless of it: :38-40 states estimated contribution as the known-hard part, :98 D-03 locks 'Contribution is always labelled an estimate, and never feeds verified proof', and :63 fixes the identical label wording across personas. An implementer building to spec produces the labelled estimate; a later owner cut removes a render, it does not require invented behaviour. The stale 'MoSCoW' target is a bookkeeping lag on an owner decision, not a missing product rule.

Quotes verify (22.05.02-alert-rules-scheduled-digests.md:27-30, :94 D-01, :53, :69). The claim that 'neither live question asks for the value' misreads them: :105 Q-02 is '[OWNER] What are the default rules for a new user? Defaults decide the noise budget in practice — almost nobody edits them ... | User | /create-prd', and :106 Q-03 asks whether the platform notification cross-cut supports a per-domain budget at all ('If the latter, D-01 is locally correct and globally useless') — both carry an owner and a target, and between them they own exactly the scope and the arithmetic of the budget. The numeric messages-per-period figure is also a tuning parameter for the notification cross-cut, not a vision-layer product statement; the behavioural rules (batch rather than fire N times, suppress over-budget rules with a stated reason) are already unambiguous at :53 and :69.

Quotes verify (22.06.02-promo-vendor-risk-scoring.md:89 D-02, :51, :64, :66, Q-01..Q-04 at :97-100). What the vision layer owes is present and unambiguous: no score below a floor, sample size always shown with the rate (:34, :51, :65), 'Unknown' state when observations are insufficient, 'Deteriorating' defined as recent rate worse than historic with recency weighted over lifetime average (:66), and retractions decrementing (:91 D-04). The specific n-floor, recency window and deterioration margin are statistical model parameters of the same class the tree routes downstream elsewhere (e.g. 22.03.01:107 Q-03 sends sync cadence to /create-prd-architecture). Two implementers converge on the same behaviour with a configurable threshold.

Quotes verify (22.02.03-match-conflict-disambiguation-resolution.md:56; 22.02.02-recording-release-catalog-matching.md:85). The behaviour is fully specified: re-contest of the same external profile with no new evidence is rate-limited, a repeated pattern is flagged to domain 24 as abuse instead of reopening the queue, and the user message is fixed ('This match was recently reviewed — new claims need new evidence'). Only the numeric window, rate and escalation count are unstated, and those are abuse-control tuning values that belong to the BE/security layer — the same layer 22.02.03:103 Q-01 routes its analogous unset duration to ('| User | /write-be-spec (surfaced to owner) |'). That a sibling happened to quantify its own throttle at 22.02.02:85 does not make an unquantified throttle here a vision-layer gap.
